# Code of Conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

## Our commitment

The Text-to-Speech AI Inference community welcomes people of different backgrounds, identities, abilities, experience levels, and perspectives. We aim to provide a respectful, inclusive, constructive, and safe environment for contributors, maintainers, reviewers, and other participants.

## Expected behavior

- Be courteous, considerate, and patient, especially when discussing technical disagreements.
- Offer specific, constructive feedback on code and ideas rather than criticizing people.
- Respect differences in language, background, knowledge, accessibility needs, and viewpoints.
- Acknowledge mistakes, consider the impact of your words, and work toward resolution.
- Respect privacy, informed consent for voice data, attribution, and the licenses of models, datasets, and dependencies.
- Avoid posting credentials, personal voice samples, or sensitive information in public discussions.
- Cooperate with project moderation decisions and discuss concerns respectfully.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, hate speech, threats, intimidation, stalking, or targeted exclusion.
- Personal attacks, insults, deliberate provocation, sustained disruption, or repeated unwelcome contact.
- Unwelcome sexual attention, comments, or imagery.
- Publishing another person's private information, credentials, recordings, or voice samples without permission.
- Impersonation or abusive voice synthesis intended to harass, mislead, or harm community members.
- Retaliation against someone who raises a concern in good faith.
- Any conduct that makes project participation hostile or unsafe.

## Scope

This policy covers project issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, and other communication channels managed by the project. It also applies when someone represents the project in a public forum or project-related event.

## Reporting

Do **not** publish conduct reports or identifying evidence in public issues.

Contact the maintainer privately using a contact method published on the [maintainer's GitHub profile](https://github.com/dangkhoa2016). If no private contact channel is available, open only a short, non-sensitive issue requesting a private reporting channel, without describing the incident or revealing the affected people.

When safe, provide relevant links, approximate dates, and context. Reports will be assessed with discretion, shared only as necessary to review the concern, and handled without retaliation. Absolute confidentiality and fixed response times cannot be guaranteed. Where the maintainer is involved, use an independent GitHub platform reporting channel when available rather than reporting to that person.

For software vulnerabilities, use the separate [Security Policy](SECURITY.md).

## Enforcement

Depending on the severity, context, and recurrence of a violation, maintainers may request changes, remove content, issue a warning, temporarily restrict participation, or permanently ban participation in project spaces. Decisions should be proportional and fair. Affected participants may request reconsideration through an appropriate private channel.

## Languages

This is the primary English Code of Conduct file recognized by GitHub. A [Vietnamese translation](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md) is available for contributors.
